## Prague
```{python}
print(f"Total number of lines: {len(prague_pubs_df)}")

print(f"Number of unique pubs: {prague_pubs_df.groupby('url').ngroups}")

prague_pubs_df = prague_pubs_df.drop_duplicates()
```

```{python}
# print all unique ratings
print("Unique ratings:")
print(prague_pubs_df['rating'].unique())
```

```{python}
import contextily as ctx
import geopandas as gpd

# Convert your DataFrame into a GeoDataFrame
# keep only one row per unique URL (first occurrence)
prague_unique = prague_pubs_df.drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="first")

gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  prague_unique,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(prague_unique.longitude, prague_unique.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"   # WGS84 lat/lon
)

# Convert to Web Mercator
gdf = gdf.to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10))
gdf.plot(ax=ax, color="blue", alpha=0.7, markersize=30)

# Add basemap
ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Voyager)

plt.title("Pubs in Prague")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# keep only rows with non-empty rating, then one row per url
mask_rated = prague_pubs_df['rating'].notna() & (prague_pubs_df['rating'].astype(str).str.strip() != '')
prague_filtered = prague_pubs_df[mask_rated]
prague_unique = prague_filtered.drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="first")

# rows without rating (also one row per url)
mask_unrated = ~mask_rated
prague_no_rating = prague_pubs_df[mask_unrated].drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="first")

# GeoDataFrames
gdf_rated = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  prague_unique,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(prague_unique.longitude, prague_unique.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf_unrated = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  prague_no_rating,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(prague_no_rating.longitude, prague_no_rating.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plot
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10))
# rated pubs (e.g., blue)
gdf_rated.plot(ax=ax, color="blue", alpha=0.7, markersize=30, label="With rating")
# unrated pubs as red points
gdf_unrated.plot(ax=ax, color="red", alpha=0.9, markersize=40, marker="x", label="No rating")

# Add basemap
ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Voyager)

plt.title("Pubs in Prague (rated = blue, no rating = red)")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
# keep only rows with non-empty rating, then one row per url
mask_rated = prague_pubs_df['rating'].notna() & (prague_pubs_df['rating'].astype(str).str.strip() != '')
prague_filtered = prague_pubs_df[mask_rated].drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="first")

# ensure rating is numeric
prague_filtered['rating_num'] = pd.to_numeric(prague_filtered['rating'], errors='coerce')
prague_filtered = prague_filtered[prague_filtered['rating_num'].notna()]

# rows without rating (also one row per url)
mask_unrated = ~mask_rated
prague_no_rating = prague_pubs_df[mask_unrated].drop_duplicates(subset="url", keep="first")

# GeoDataFrames
gdf_rated = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  prague_filtered,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(prague_filtered.longitude, prague_filtered.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf_unrated = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  prague_no_rating,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(prague_no_rating.longitude, prague_no_rating.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plot: color by rating (1 = red, 5 = green) using RdYlGn colormap
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10))

# plot unrated first so rated points are on top
if not gdf_unrated.empty:
    gdf_unrated.plot(ax=ax, color="lightgray", alpha=0.8, markersize=40, marker="x", label="No rating")

# scatter rated points with colormap
ratings = gdf_rated['rating_num'].astype(float)
x = gdf_rated.geometry.x
y = gdf_rated.geometry.y

cmap = plt.get_cmap('RdYlGn')   # low=red, high=green
norm = plt.Normalize(vmin=1, vmax=5)

sc = ax.scatter(x, y, c=ratings, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, s=40, edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.2, alpha=0.9, label="With rating")

# Add basemap
ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Voyager)

plt.title("Pubs in Prague (colored by rating: 1=red ... 5=green)")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.legend()

# colorbar for the ratings
cbar = plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, fraction=0.03, pad=0.02)
cbar.set_label('Rating')

plt.show()
```

```{python}
# keep only rows with non-empty rating, then one row per url
# determine whether each restaurant (unique url) has at least one non-empty menu_item
has_menu = prague_pubs_df.groupby('url')['menu_item'].apply(
  lambda s: (s.notna() & (s.astype(str).str.strip() != '')).any()
)

# take first row per url for coords/metadata and attach flag
prague_unique = prague_pubs_df.drop_duplicates(subset='url', keep='first').set_index('url')
prague_unique['has_menu'] = has_menu.reindex(prague_unique.index).fillna(False)

# split into with/without menu
with_menu = prague_unique[prague_unique['has_menu']]
no_menu = prague_unique[~prague_unique['has_menu']]

# GeoDataFrames
gdf_with = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  with_menu,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(with_menu.longitude, with_menu.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf_no = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  no_menu,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(no_menu.longitude, no_menu.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plot: blue dots = has menu, red X = no menu
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10))
if not gdf_no.empty:
  gdf_no.plot(ax=ax, color="red", marker="x", markersize=50, alpha=0.9, label="No menu")
if not gdf_with.empty:
  gdf_with.plot(ax=ax, color="blue", markersize=30, alpha=0.8, label="Has menu")

ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Voyager)
plt.title("Pubs in Prague (has menu = blue, no menu = red)")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.legend()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
import re

# parse price like "150 Kč" (or "150-200 Kč") -> numeric (mean if multiple numbers)
def parse_price(s):
  if pd.isna(s):
    return np.nan
  nums = re.findall(r'\d+', str(s))
  if not nums:
    return np.nan
  nums = [int(n) for n in nums]
  return float(np.mean(nums))

# create numeric price column per row
prague_pubs_df['price_num'] = prague_pubs_df.get('price', prague_pubs_df.get('menu_price', pd.Series([np.nan]*len(prague_pubs_df)))).apply(parse_price)

# average price per unique URL (restaurant/pub)
price_avg = prague_pubs_df.groupby('url')['price_num'].apply(lambda s: s.dropna().mean())

# take first row per url for coords/metadata and attach avg_price
prague_unique = prague_pubs_df.drop_duplicates(subset='url', keep='first').set_index('url')
prague_unique['avg_price'] = price_avg.reindex(prague_unique.index)

# split into with/without avg_price
with_price = prague_unique[prague_unique['avg_price'].notna()].reset_index()
no_price = prague_unique[prague_unique['avg_price'].isna()].reset_index()

# GeoDataFrames
gdf_with = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  with_price,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(with_price.longitude, with_price.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

gdf_no = gpd.GeoDataFrame(
  no_price,
  geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(no_price.longitude, no_price.latitude),
  crs="EPSG:4326"
).to_crs(epsg=3857)

# Plot: cheapest (green) -> most expensive (red). Use reversed RdYlGn so low=green, high=red.
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10,10))

if not gdf_no.empty:
  gdf_no.plot(ax=ax, color="lightgray", alpha=0.8, markersize=40, marker="x", label="No price")

if not gdf_with.empty:
  prices = gdf_with['avg_price'].astype(float)
  x = gdf_with.geometry.x
  y = gdf_with.geometry.y

  cmap = plt.get_cmap('RdYlGn_r')   # reversed: low=green, high=red
  vmin = prices.min()
  vmax = prices.max()
  if np.isclose(vmin, vmax):
    vmin = max(0, vmin - 1)
    vmax = vmax + 1
  norm = plt.Normalize(vmin=vmin, vmax=vmax)

  sc = ax.scatter(x, y, c=prices, cmap=cmap, norm=norm, s=50, edgecolor='k', linewidth=0.2, alpha=0.9, label="With avg price")

# Add basemap
ctx.add_basemap(ax, source=ctx.providers.CartoDB.Voyager)

plt.title("Pubs in Prague (colored by average price; green=cheapest, red=most expensive)")
plt.xlabel("Longitude")
plt.ylabel("Latitude")
plt.legend()

# colorbar for average price
if 'sc' in locals():
  cbar = plt.colorbar(sc, ax=ax, fraction=0.03, pad=0.02)
  cbar.set_label('Average price (Kč)')

plt.show()
```
